paper_type_evidence.quote: We present new Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array CO(5–4) observations of nine gas-rich post-starburst galaxies at $z\sim0.7$

question.value: What is the CO excitation (r52) of the molecular gas in gas-rich z~0.7 post-starburst galaxies, and does it indicate buried star formation or non-stellar heating?

evidence.quote: Together, these data allow us to assess whether gas-rich SQuIGG$\vec{L}$E PSBs host molecular gas with CO excitation consistent with diffuse and quiescent systems
(PI: D’Onofrio; Program #2024.1.01252.S)

evidence.quote: we obtained ALMA Band 7 observations of the CO(5–4) transition

spectral line sensitivities that range $\approx$300-500 $\mu\rm{Jy}\,\rm{beam}^{-1}$ per channel

findings_qualitative.value: No clear trend between r52 and total or surface-density SFR

evidence.quote: The SQuIGG$\vec{L}$E galaxies show no clear trend between excitation ratio and either total or surface-density SFR.

claims.hypothesis: Gas-rich PSBs at z~0.7 have high CO excitation from buried star formation
claims.experiment: CO(5-4) ALMA observations of 9 PSBs, r52 vs SFR and Sigma_SFR
claims.result: r52≈0.1-0.3 for most, no trend with SFR
claims.finding: Moderate excitation, suppressed SF efficiency, no strong buried starburst needed

evidence.quote: indicating that the remaining gas hosts relatively suppressed star formation efficiencies instead of strong buried starburst activity

claims.experiment: Compare J1448+1010 to SFR-driven models and AGN indicators
claims.finding: Likely AGN heating plus possible obscured SF

evidence.quote: its elevated excitation likely requires significant non-stellar heating

why_this_data.value: Most gas-rich objects chosen to ensure efficient CO(5-4) detection

evidence.quote: selected as the most molecular gas-rich systems ($M_{\rm{H}_2}$$>10^{10.25}$ $M_\odot$) ensuring efficient detection of the CO(5–4) transition

limitations_admitted.value: Small sample with limited dynamic range in excitation

evidence.quote: though the sample is small and spans a limited dynamic range in excitation

referee_caveats_inferred: Only two CO transitions; no radiative transfer modeling
alpha_CO and r21 assumptions affect masses
Comparison sample differs in mass and redshift
Extended emission only compared with central regions

reproducibility.score_reason: Data identified and workflow simple, but imaging and fitting details sparse and key inputs inherited.
